learner_operation: Identify two factors, differentiate the appropriate factor(s), preserve the undifferentiated partner, and combine using u'v+uv'. Read the displayed scaffold to determine which summand is missing. Distinguish product-rule, sign, power, exponential-base and logarithmic-base errors.

fixed_features.feature: Two-factor first derivative and source-style fragment or five-choice response
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 2622 and the 17 practice questions establish u′v+uv′, with no point evaluation.

fixed_features.feature: Easy-sized atomic factors and small parameter bounds
fixed_features.justification: Sources use powers, simple exponent scales, trig factors and log bases. Root-order and nonlinear nesting changes would add derivative/simplification workload.

fixed_features.feature: One missing product-rule term per blank
fixed_features.justification: Source scaffolds supply the other contribution; full derivative is not a valid missing fragment.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Either left u′v or right uv′ at fixed factors, with printed minus for a negative second contribution.
answer_roles.observed: Both targets in each blank family before and after deduplication; controlled cosine swap passes native grading and UI checks.

answer_roles.role: Exponential sign and relative exponential/logarithmic bases
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Positive/negative simple scales and equal/unequal bases as in q-320814/815/816.
answer_roles.observed: Sampling code independently draws b,d and k; both signs retained. Controlled sign change is consistent.

answer_roles.role: Correct radio option position and coefficients
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Correct pair can change with c,n,k,b; bank directions/placement and option order may change.
answer_roles.observed: Conditional position and length probes do not establish a reproducible perfect predictor; log-log scalar doubling is intended product-rule simplification, not an incidental label.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Allow zero additive constant to include canonical x^2 ln x; h also changes the right target without changing the left.
answer_roles.observed: h=1..5 only; canonical h=0 is rejected. Relevant/irrelevant h changes within admitted range behave correctly.

counterfactuals.change: Hold b=7 and 7^x cos(x) fixed; switch omitted left term to right term.
counterfactuals.expected: Answer changes from 7^x ln7 cos(x) to positive 7^x sin(x), with printed subtraction.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompts switch mask, solutions preserve full derivative and sign, both correct entries accepted and cross entries rejected.
counterfactuals.justification: q-319421/q-319425/q-311231 specify product-rule fragments; either contribution is eligible.

counterfactuals.change: Hold b=5,d=7 and left target fixed; replace 5^x by 5^-x.
counterfactuals.expected: Answer changes sign and exponential; supplied second term changes exponential too.
counterfactuals.observed: Both prompts and solution reflect the sign; native own-key accepts and opposite-key rejects.
counterfactuals.justification: q-320816 demonstrates negative linear exponent and unequal bases.

counterfactuals.change: Hold n=3 and right target fixed; h=1 ->5 in (x^3+h)ln x.
counterfactuals.observed: Native grader accepts each own answer and rejects the other; solutions and UI follow h.
counterfactuals.justification: q-320824 requires retaining the undifferentiated polynomial in uv′.

counterfactuals.change: Hold n=3 and left target fixed; h=1 ->5 in (x^3+h)ln x.
counterfactuals.expected: Missing term stays 3x^2 ln x while the known term changes.
counterfactuals.observed: Responses preserve exact equality; native cross answers accept in both directions; rendered prompts and explanations show changed h.
counterfactuals.justification: Derivative of constant h is zero, as the source factor-derivative stages imply.
